projects.title: Lunch Box
projects.summary: A graded project developed with my team to simulate a lunch box ordering system sololy built on Java with SQL database. We were tasked with developing a lunch box ordering system that would allow users to order lunch boxes from a menu, and for the system to keep track of the orders and the inventory.
